pages.text: Big snowflakes fell heavily all night. Yard snow reached Nils's knees.
Nils wanted a snowman taller than himself. "I'm the best at making snowmen!"
Grandpa rolled a snowball along the ground. Nils shook his head. "Slow. Just pile up the snow."
Nils scooped snow in both arms and piled it. Plop, plop, plop. Up to his tummy.
More on top. Shoulders, then the top of his head!
The snow pile leaned sideways. Nils held it with both hands.
Poof! It collapsed. Snow lay scattered in the yard. His cheeks reddened.
Grandpa rolled his snowball again. Round and round, until it reached his knee.
Nils rolled one too. Round, round, round. It grew as big as Nils!
Grandpa put a little snowball on top. Pinecone eyes, branch arms. "Rolling makes it grow!" Nils leaned his head far back.
